channel.title: Capital raising: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New capital raising filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: GnCo decided a third-party allotment rights offering of 1,113,172 new common shares at KRW 2,695 each, to repay convertible bond debt.
Aprogen resolved on Nov 20, 2026 to issue 1,428,571 new common shares at KRW 1,400 each via a public offering.
Kwangjin Industrial's board resolved on 2 Nov 2026 to issue KRW 10.0bn (100억원) of Series 5 private convertible bonds, due 16 Nov 2029.
